title: Implementation of Black and Wiliam’s Formative Assessment Framework in The Merdeka Curriculum: Enabling Factors and Challenges in Elementary Education
abstract: Formative assessment is positioned as a core component of learner-centred instruction in the Merdeka Curriculum, however, its implementation in elementary schools/madrasah ibtidaiyah (SD/MI) remains constrained. This study analyzes the implementation of formative assessment based on Black & Wiliam (2009) framework, with a focus on the enabling and contraining factors shaping its practice in SD/MI. A qualitative approach with a collective case study design was employed across five schools implementing the Merdeka Curriculum. Data were generated through non-participant observation, semi-structured interviews, and document analysis and analyzed thematically across cases. The findings show that formative assessment practices are enabled by teachers’ assessment experience and literacy, principals’ academic supervision, student engagement, and the availability of supportive curriculum resources. Conversely, implementation remains limited by restricted instructional time, large class sizes, the dominance of summative assessment, and weak mastery of reflective assessment strategies, particularly self-assessment. These findings suggest that formative assessment in SD/MI remains developmenta

title: The Effect of Animated Video Media on Madrasah Ibtidaiyah Students Listening Skills
abstract: Tujuan dari penelitian ini untuk megetahui penerapan penggunaan video animasi terhadap kemampuan menyimak siswa dalam kegiatan pembelajaran dan melihat pengaruh penggunaan video animasi pada kemampuan menyimak peserta didik. Pendekatan yang dipakai adalah kuantitatif, dengan menggunakan desain Non equivalent Control Group Design. Sampel terdiri dari 56 peserta didik. Metode pengumpulan data meliputi penilaian prettes, posttest, lembar pengamatan, dan dokumentasi. Ananlisis data memakai Uji t sampel independen. Hasil Penelitian menyatakan (1) implementasi penggunaan video animasi pada kemampuan menyimak peserta didik dalam kegiatan pembelajaran memperoleh kategori baik. Yang berarti bahwa indikator pembelajaran terlaksana dengan baik. (2) Hasil Uji t sampel independen, memperoleh nilai signifikansi yakni 0,000

title: Application of The Student Active Learning (SAL) Model Based on Local Wisdom to Improve Critical Thinking in Primary School
abstract: This study was motivated by the low critical thinking skills of fourth-grade students at SDN Inpres Doridungga in IPAS subjects, with only 39% of students achieving learning completeness. This problem is caused by conventional learning methods that have not integrated the context of students' lives, especially local wisdom values. This study aims to improve students' critical thinking skills through the application of the Student Active Learning (SAL) model based on the local wisdom of Bima Regency. The research method used is Kurt Lewin's Classroom Action Research (CAR) model, which was carried out in two cycles. The research subjects were 18 fourth-grade students, consisting of 10 male students and 8 female students. The research instruments included observation sheets, critical thinking skills tests, and student response questionnaires The research findings indicate an improvement in students’ critical thinking skills from Cycle I to Cycle II, with the mastery rate increasing from 17% in Cycle I to 79% in Cycle II, thereby meeting the established mastery target. The integration of the local wisdom of Rimpu Bima, Uma Lengge, and Mbolo Weki in learning proved to be effective in cr

title: The Effect of The Use of Genially-Based Interactive Learning Media on Interest in Learning Mathematics in Elementary School Students
abstract: This research aims to determine how students' interest in learning mathematics changes before and after using interactive learning media based on Genially. Additionally, it also examines how the use of this media impacts fifth-grade students at SD Negeri 03 Gumawang. The research method used is experimental quantitative and employs a one-group Pretest-Posttest design. Systematic sampling was used to determine the research subjects, which consisted of 30 students. The tools used to collect data include observation, questionnaires, and interviews. Then, to determine the difference between before and after the treatment, a series of statistical tests were used, including normality, validity, and reliability tests, as well as the paired sample t-test. The results of the data processing show that after the use of Genially media, students' interest in learning antematika increased. The average student score increased from 46.41 before the treatment to 53.65 after the treatment. Furthermore, it can be concluded that the use of Genially-based learning media has a significant impact on students' interest in learning. The results of the statistical test show a significance value of 0.000, wh

title: Systematic Literature Review: Transforming Learning Through Artificial Sintelligence (AI) and Challenges for Educators in Elementary School Learning
abstract: This study aims to analyze the transformation of artificial intelligence (AI)- based learning and identify the challenges of its implementation in elementary schools. The method used was a Systematic Literature Review (SLR) of 15 articles from relevant national and international journals. The results show that AI can transform learning to be more personalized, interactive, and adaptive, and increase learning effectiveness through automated feedback and student data analysis. Furthermore, the role of teachers shifts to that of facilitators and collaborators. However, AI implementation still faces various challenges, such as limited teacher competency, infrastructure, and ethical and privacy issues. Therefore, comprehensive preparedness is needed to ensure optimal and sustainable use of AI to support improvements in the quality of elementary education.

title: Development of Local Culture-Based Tpack E-Books Improves Creativity & Cultural Literacy of Elementary School Students
abstract: Science learning, especially on social science-based materials, has an important role in instilling character, social skills, and cultural understanding from an early age. However, in practice, social studies learning in elementary schools is still dominated by the use of printed and abstract teaching materials, which is reinforced by the researcher's findings where limited use of technology still occurs in the learning process at SDN Sumberjo 1. This study aims to develop and test the validity, feasibility, and effectiveness of local culture-based e-books with the TPACK approach on the cultural diversity material of science for grade IV SDN Sumberjo 1, Blitar Regency. The research method used is RnD with the ASSURE model through the stages of needs analysis, formulation of objectives, selection of media and materials, limited trials, expert validation, and product evaluation and revision. Data were collected through interviews, observations, questionnaires, and pretest-posttest tests and then analyzed qualitatively and quantitatively using the N-Gain test. The results of the validation by material, language, and media experts showed an average percentage of 92.15% with a very vali

title: Integration of EDS Values Through The PBLH Movement for Strengthening Environmental Care Character in Islamic Primary School
abstract: This study analyzes the integration of Education for Sustainable Development (ESD) values through the Environmental Care and Culture Movement in Schools (PBLHS) to strengthen environmental care character at MIN 4 Demak. The issue is important because schools should not merely promote cleanliness habits, but should connect environmental awareness with ecological sustainability, social responsibility, and prudent resource use. The research employed a qualitative case study approach. Data were collected through interviews, observation, documentation, and analysis of the school profile, the four-year PBLHS plan, monitoring and evaluation reports, and interview guidelines. The findings show that ESD values were integrated through written planning, daily habituation, environmental learning integration, teacher role modelling, and periodic evaluation based on behavioral change and physical environmental conditions. Core activities included waste sorting, 3R practices, water and energy conservation, greening programs, seedling cultivation, tree planting, biopore development, and campaigns to reduce plastic waste. The study indicates that PBLHS not only cultivates cleanliness habits but als

title: The Implementation of Project-Based Learning Based on The Utilization of Telang Flowers to Enhance Students’ Creativity
abstract: The low creative thinking ability of elementary school students requires learning that is more contextual, active, and grounded in direct experience. This study aims to describe the implementation of Project-Based Learning using blue pea flowers to strengthen students’ creativity at SD Alam Lampung. The study employed a qualitative approach with a case study design. Informants included the principal, teachers, students, and parents selected purposively. Data were collected through observation, semi-structured interviews, documentation, and analysis of students’ products, then analyzed through data reduction, data display, and conclusion drawing. Findings show that PjBL based on blue pea flowers engaged students in observing, designing, processing, producing, presenting, and reflecting on their products. Students’ creativity appeared in fluency, flexibility, originality, and elaboration through ecoprint, blue pea bika ambon, blue pea pancakes, milk pudding, and lemon blue pea drinks. The study concludes that blue pea flowers can serve as a local project medium for strengthening creativity. The implication is that teachers can use nearby natural materials as creative, collaborative,

title: Development of The "Arkanuh" Application to Enhance Elementary School Students' Understanding of The History of Prophet Noah
abstract: This study aims to develop and test the feasibility and effectiveness of the ARKANUH application, an augmented reality (AR)-based learning media on the story of Prophet Noah for second-grade elementary school students. This research employed the Design and Development (D&D) approach with the ADDIE development model, which includes the stages of analysis, design, development, implementation, and evaluation. The research subjects were second-grade students of SDN Pataruman, Darmaraja District, Sumedang Regency. Data collection techniques included expert validation questionnaires, observation, pre-test, post-test, and interviews. The validation results from media experts reached a percentage of 86.5% (very good) and from material experts 84.2% (good), indicating that the application is feasible to use. The product trial showed an improvement in student understanding with an average N-Gain score of 0.6966 (69.66%), which falls into the moderately effective category with a moderate–high increase. Student and teacher responses were highly positive regarding the ease of use and appeal of the application. Thus, the ARKANUH application is proven effective in improving learning outcomes and

title: The Effect of The CIRC Learning Model with Flipbook Media on Madrasah Ibtidaiyah Students Reading Comprehension Skills
abstract: This study was conducted in response to issues faced by students regarding the gap in reading proficiency between those who read fluently and those who still struggle, the limited use of interactive learning media and cooperative learning approaches, and the predominant reliance on conventional methods in face-to-face instruction. This study aims to determine the effect of the CIRC learning model assisted by flipbook media on the reading comprehension skills of fourth-grade students at MIMA 7 Labuan Ratu. This is a quantitative study using a quasi-experimental design. The study population consists of all 47 fourth-grade students. Class IVA, with 23 students, served as the experimental class implementing the learning model supported by flipbook media, while Class IVB, with 24 students, served as the control class implementing the SQ3R model. The sampling technique used was census sampling, employing multiple-choice questions to measure reading comprehension skills. The results of this study indicate that there is a significant effect of the CIRC learning model assisted by flipbook media on the reading comprehension skills of fourth-grade students at MIMA 7 Labuan Ratu. title: Reducing Classroom Anxiety in First-Grade Elementary Students Through Ice Breaking Strategies
abstract: This study explores the effectiveness of ice breaking strategies in reducing classroom anxiety among first-grade students at Ma’had Al-Zaytun Elementary School. Using a qualitative descriptive approach, data were collected through classroom observations, interviews, and document analysis. Findings show that anxiety is influenced by emotional, social, and environmental factors. Ice breaking activities significantly reduced anxiety by creating a more relaxed and engaging classroom atmosphere. The results suggest that integrating emotional support strategies such as ice breaking into early-grade pedagogy enhances student readiness and participation in learning.

title: Design and Influence of Electrical Energy Transformation Demonstration Method on Elementary School Student Understanding
abstract: This study discusses the Design and Effect of Demonstration Methods of Electrical Energy Transformation Material on students at Elementary School Inpres 6/86 Biru Bone Regency, the purpose of this study was to determine: 1) Feasibility of Designing Electrical Energy Transformation Media, 2) Students' understanding of electrical energy transformation material before and after using the demonstration method. The type of research used is quantitative research, pre-experimental design research with a one-group pretest-posttest form with a pedagogical approach. The population in grade IV is 25 students. Data analysis techniques are descriptive analysis and inferential data. The results of the study obtained were students' feel safe, comfortable (the design is made from wood material and the electricity source is not high voltage) and understanding of electrical energy transformation material before applying the demonstration method with an average value of 46.25, while after applying the demonstration method the average value reached 80.42. So students' understanding of electrical energy transformation material has increased. The results of the t-test obtained a value (pretest-posttest)

title: Inclusive Learning Transformation: Implementation of Universal Design for Learning on Indonesian Subjects in Elementary Schools
abstract: Indonesian language learning in elementary schools strategically builds students' literacy, character, and communication skills. However, challenges such as diversity in learning styles, cultural backgrounds, and special needs require an inclusive and adaptive learning approach. Universal Design for Learning (UDL) offers a flexible framework for designing accessible instruction to all students. This study examines the concepts and strategies for implementing UDL in Indonesian language learning in elementary education through a qualitative document-based approach. The study uses a literature review method, relying on data sources from books, articles, policies, reports, and academic literature. The data were analyzed critically and systematically without field research, applying the PRISMA search strategy to find relevant articles. The study results indicate that the principles of UDL, which consist of representation, expression, action, and engagement, can improve accessibility, participation, and student learning success. Implementing UDL encourages diverse learning media, flexible assessment, and a learning environment responsive to individual needs. Thus, UDL is a pedagogical st

title: Implementing the Hidden Curriculum: Character Building in Elementary School Students Through Habituation
abstract: The current phenomenon shows that character education is very important in the education system, especially at the elementary education level, including in Madrasah Ibtidaiyah (MI). Character is necessary in shaping students' personalities in accordance with Islamic values. Hidden curriculum is a curriculum that includes norms, values, and habits that are formed through social interactions and the school environment without being explicitly stated in formal curriculum documents. The method used in this study is a descriptive method with a phenomenological approach. The results obtained show that the forms of habituation applied in Madrasah Ibtidaiyah Fitrah Insani include: habituation of Worship, including activities usually carried out at school: congregational Dhuha and Dzuhur prayers, reading Asmaul Husana, daily prayers read together, reading the Quran and Tahfidz, Ethical and social habits including getting used to 5S saying greetings, greetings, smiling, being polite and courteous, getting used to queuing and discipline, getting used to working together and caring for society. Academic habits, independence, and responsibility include taking responsibility for assignments and

title: Integration of Discipline Character Education in Scout Marching Activities at State Special Needs School
abstract: This study aims to describe the implementation of Scout activities in fostering discipline-based character education for students with special needs at SLB Negeri 1 Amuntai. This study employed a qualitative research approach, using interviews, observations, and documentation as data collection techniques. The subjects included the Scout instructor and all students of SLB Negeri 1 Amuntai. Data were analyzed inductively following the steps proposed by Creswell, and data validity was ensured through triangulation. The results showed that the implementation of marching activities faced challenges, particularly with students who have autism. However, these challenges were effectively managed through specific strategies, including individualized guidance, the use of visual cues (hand gestures), and the assistance of a dedicated support team. The study found that these activities successfully cultivated two key character values: orderliness (tertib) and obedience. Orderliness was observed in students' punctuality and adherence to uniform policies, while obedience was demonstrated through their response to the instructor's commands, which aligns with Thorndike's stimulus-response theory.

title: The Role of Extracurricular Activities in Forming Students’s Character
abstract: This study aims to determine the role of extracurricular activities in shaping students' character education. Character education is an important aspect in the process of forming students' personalities from an early age, and extracurricular activities are considered as one of the effective media in instilling these values. The method used in this study is a descriptive qualitative method with data collection techniques through observation, interviews with teachers and students, and documentation of extracurricular activities. The results of the study indicate that extracurricular activities at SDN 190 Cenning, such as Scouting, sports, and arts, are able to foster character values such as discipline, responsibility, cooperation, self-confidence, and social concern. The role of the supervising teacher is also very important in guiding students so that they can take positive values from each activity carried out. Thus, it can be concluded that extracurricular activities in schools contribute positively to the formation of students' character.

title: Formation of children's character Through habituation methods in early childhood and elementary school
abstract: Character is a very important thing for every child to have. In developing children's character, effective and efficient learning methods such as habituation methods are needed. The purpose of this study is to describe the development of children's character after the application of habituation methods in learning. The research method uses a qualitative research approach with a phenomenological research type. The data collection technique uses interviews and observations. The results of this study show that there is good development after the application of the habituation method in early childhood and elementary school.

title: Improving Understanding of Science Concepts Through Cell at Work Learning Media in Elementary School
abstract: This study examines the effect of Cells at Work animation material on the understanding of circulatory system material of grade V students of SDN 1 Selong. This research uses content validity formula with Likert scale in validity test. This study also used the KR-20 formula and Chronbach's alpha in the reliability test. This technique uses the Kolmogorov-Smirnov formula in the condition test. This study also used the arithmetic mean formula in the observation form. Finally, this study used hypothesis testing with a two-sided t-test. This study used SPSS 25.0 software for Windows. This study used a pretest-posttest control group design with 39 students to collect information on learning outcomes and observation results. Data analysis included validity, reliability, and t-test. The results showed that the material expert validation was very good (87.3%) and the instrument was reliable (r value = 0.602>r table = 0.600). The observation results were also good. title: The Development of a Storybook on Banten Culture as A Literacy Medium for Elementary and Islamic Elementary School Student
abstract: Fun and easy-to-understand literacy media for students are limited in availability. Current student literacy activities are quite concerning. Various parties in the world of education are asked to formulate ideas for both products and services to facilitate elementary school students in literacy activities. In addition, government regulations emphasize that there must be cultural elements or elaborate on local cultural wisdom in order to get closer to the learning by doing process. One of the various literacy media that is currently being developed is the development of Banten cultural legend books as a literacy medium for elementary school students. The purpose of this study is to transform the contextual story of Banten folklore in the form of "The Legend of Mount Pinang" which is suitable for use by students and to analyze student responses to Banten cultural legend books as a literacy medium. The R&D (Research and Development) method with the 4D model (Define, Design, Develop, Disseminate) was used in this study. The results of the study showed that the Banten cultural smart book developed and validated by three validators obtained a very high level of feasibility (more than 90

title: Maharah Kalam Learning with Cooperative Modle Type Co-Op in Madrasah Ibtidaiyah Banjarmasin
abstract: This study investigates the implementation of the Maharah Kalam (Arabic speaking skill) learning using the co-op cooperative model in a 6th-grade Madrasah Ibtidaiyah. Observations revealed low student participation due to a lack of Arabic comprehension and confidence. The research, employing a qualitative descriptive method with interviews, observations, and questionnaires, found that while teachers optimize Maharah Kalam instruction, some steps are missed due to class management issues. Key obstacles included students' lack of confidence, insufficient practice, and limited vocabulary. Solutions proposed involve teachers encouraging student participation, providing speaking opportunities, and promoting vocabulary memorization using dictionaries.

title: Educational Leadership in Islamic Perspective and Its Implications for the Formation of Future Generations
abstract: This study aims to examine the role of leadership in Islamic education and its implications for the formation of future generations through a literature review approach. Through this approach, various classical and contemporary sources are systematically analyzed to formulate a comprehensive understanding of Islamic leadership within the context of educational institutions. The findings indicate that Islamic education possesses strong and integrated normative, philosophical, and theological foundations. Leadership in Islamic education is not merely structural but also moral and spiritual, exemplifying prophetic values such as trustworthiness (amanah), justice, and exemplary conduct. Effective leadership plays a vital role in creating an educational environment conducive to character formation among learners. Thus, Islamic leadership serves as a crucial element in nurturing a generation that excels intellectually and spiritually, capable of addressing contemporary challenges through the noble values of Islam

title: The Voice of Inclusion from Madrasah Ibtidaiyah
abstract: This research highlights the practice of inclusive education in Madrasah Ibtidaiyah (MI) as a concrete manifestation of fulfilling every child's right to education without discrimination. The aim of this study is to explore the voices of inclusion within the MI educational environment through various perspectives: the head of the madrasah, teachers, parents, and students. This research seeks to understand how inclusion is implemented in madrasahs and what model of inclusive education is used by the institutions. A qualitative method with a phenomenological approach was employed. The main focus is directed at the opinions of heads of madrasahs, teachers, parents, and students who are part of the inclusion process, gathered through interviews and field observations at five MI in Cilacap Regency. The findings indicate that: (1) Facilities and infrastructure remain very limited, (2) There is a lack of trained human resources, (3) There is a lack of understanding about inclusive education, (4) Funding is insufficient, (5) Flexible curricula are limited, (6) Negative perceptions toward students with special needs persist, (7) Collaboration between stakeholders is lacking, (8) Students fa

title: Representation of Patriotic Values in Arabic Language Textbooks: A Semiotic Perspective in Indonesian Elementary Schools
abstract: This study aims to reveal the representation of patriotic values in Arabic textbooks for grade IV Madrasah Ibtidaiyah through Roland Barthes' semiotic approach. The method used is text and visual analysis at three levels of meaning: denotative, connotative, and mythological. The results show that symbols such as "I Love Indonesia", the National Monument, and Borobudur Temple are used to instill patriotic values such as love for the homeland, national identity, and cultural identity. Textbooks function as ideological instruments that construct patriotism within an Islamic framework through a structured sign system, both visually and verbally in learning

title: Character Education Development through the LSTEAM Approach-Based Boarding School Program at Ma'had Al-Zaytun
abstract: Character education is an effort to prepare a strong future generation in facing the challenges of 21st century technological developments. This study aims to explain the concept, implementation, and reflection on LSTEAM-based character education (Law Science, Technology, Engineering, Art, and Mathematics) for elementary school students through a boarding school program at Ma'had Al-Zaytun. This study uses a descriptive qualitative method through interview, observation, and documentation techniques. The sample in this study included administrators of the Ma'had Al-Zaytun Foundation, students, and parents of students from Madrasah Ibtidaiyah (MI) or boarding elementary schools. Data analysis included data reduction, data presentation, and drawing conclusions. The results of this study indicate that character education can be built through concepts or ideas based on LSTEAM then implemented in the daily activities of boarding school students and the results can be seen in the character of students at home and in the community.

title: Revitalization of Islamic Character Education in Elementary Madrasah Through an Integrative Approach: a Critical Literature Review
abstract: This study aims to examine the concept of Islamic character education in elementary madrasas through an integrative approach that combines spiritual, social, and intellectual values within the framework of basic education. Using library research methods, the author reviewed various classical and contemporary literature related to Islamic character education, madrasa curricula, and national education policies. The results indicate that Islamic character education has not been fully integrated into learning practices, particularly in the context of thematic learning in the Independent Curriculum. An integrative approach offers a conceptual solution by unifying cognitive, affective, and psychomotor dimensions based on Islamic values such as siddiq, amanah, fathanah, and tabligh. This study recommends that curriculum development and learning methods in MI (Islamic elementary schools) consider character dimensions comprehensively and contextually. These findings are relevant for policy development, strengthening the role of teachers, and enriching the literature on Islamic character education at the elementary level.

title: Strengthening Religious Moderation Attitudes Through Multicultural Problem Based Learning in Elementary/Madrasah Ibtidaiyah Schools
abstract: In the context of Indonesia's pluralistic society, strengthening values such as tolerance, non- violence, respect for differences, and love for the country is very important to be instilled from an early age, in the context of multicultural approach learning allows students not only to understand the teaching material, but also to develop an inclusive attitude and openness to religious, cultural, and ethnic diversity. The purpose of this study is to examine the effectiveness of the application of problem-based learning with a multicultural approach in strengthening religious moderation attitudes in elementary/madrasah ibtidaiyah schools level students. This research uses quantitative methods with the method used is a survey questionnaire using goggle form. The results showed that the majority of teachers had a very positive perception of the application of this model. Multicultural problem-based learning is considered capable of fostering tolerant attitudes, encouraging collaboration across identities, and strengthening students' understanding of the values of religious moderation in a contextual manner. The implications of this research indicate the importance of curriculum develo

title: Development of a Web-Based IPAS E-Module Integrating Differentiated Learning Styles and Computational Thinking to Improve Science Literacy in Elementary School Students
abstract: This study aims to develop a web-based electronic module (e-module) called https://ruangcipta.my.id/ that integrates computational thinking and differentiated learning styles to support IPAS (Natural and Social Sciences) learning for elementary school students in Phase B. The research adopts the ADDIE development model, which includes the stages of Analysis, Design, Development, Implementation, and Evaluation. Validity testing was conducted by experts in content, media, and language using a content validity instrument; practicality testing involved teacher and student responses; and effectiveness testing used a one-group pretest-posttest design with a literacy test instrument based on PISA indicators. The findings show that the teacher account on the e-module web https://ruangcipta.my.id/guru/login and the student account on https://ruangcipta.my.id/siswa/login meet the criteria of being valid, practical, and effective. Expert validation scores indicate high relevance, especially in terms of content accuracy, visual design, and language clarity. Responses from teachers and students show that the module is easy to use, engaging, and supportive of individual learning styles. The effe

title: “Pedagogy Based Classroom Management Strategies: A Case Study of Teachers at Public Elementary School
abstract: This qualitative study aims to describe and analyze the classroom management strategies based on a pedagogical approach implemented by teachers at SD Negeri 24/II Koto Jayo, Pelepat Subdistrict, Bungo Regency, Jambi Province. The research adopts a single case study design involving seven homeroom teachers and two subject teachers as participants. Data were collected through participatory observation, in-depth interviews, and documentation. The findings reveal that the teachers planned classroom management systematically by organizing seating arrangements, setting clear class rules, and preparing detailed lesson plans. In practice, they created a supportive learning atmosphere through interactive teaching methods, ice breaking activities, and fostering positive communication between teachers and students. The study also finds that teachers addressed disruptive behavior not merely through punishment but by identifying underlying causes and involving students in setting classroom norms. Supporting factors include well-planned curricula, teachers’ pedagogical competence, and school support, while inhibiting factors are limited facilities, large class sizes, and students’ lack of awaren

title: ANALISIS PENERAPAN PENDEKATAN TPACK BERBANTU QUIZIZZ SEBAGAI TEKNIK PENILAIAN FORMATIF DI SEKOLAH DASAR
abstract: In the era of digital transformation, education in Indonesia has undergone significant changes with the demand to integrate technology in learning. This study aims to analyze the implementation of the TPACK approach assisted by Quizizz as a formative assessment technique in class VI of SD Negeri 01 Gumawang. The research method used is a qualitative approach, with data collection techniques through observation and interviews with teachers and students. The results of the study show that the use of Quizizz increases student motivation and involvement in the learning process, where students feel more enthusiastic and active when taking quizzes, while teachers can provide real-time feedback. However, there are challenges in terms of students' technical skills and administrative burdens that limit teachers' time to prepare questions. Overall, the implementation of the TPACK approach through Quizizz has proven effective in improving the quality of formative assessment, which is in line with the needs of education in the digital era.

title: PENGEMBANGAN MEDIA AUDIO VISUAL ANIMASI BERORIENTASI BUDAYA PONTIANAK PADA MATERI DAERAHKU KEBANGGAANKU DI SEKOLAH DASAR
abstract: The animated audiovisual media that teachers have been using are generally not self-made and do not incorporate local cultural elements of the students, resulting in low effectiveness in increasing learning interest and understanding of regional culture. This study aims to develop Pontianak-oriented animated audiovisual media that can be used in the learning process of fifth-grade students at SDN 33 Pontianak Barat to support the implementation of the independent curriculum. This study employs the Research and Development (R&D) method using the ADDIE model approach. Data collection is conducted through measurement instruments and interviews. The developed materials are validated by experts, achieving a validity rate of 99% from content experts, 97% from media experts, and 91% from language experts, all falling within the “Highly Valid” category. Teachers' responses to the media reached 95% in the “Very Readable” category, while students' responses reached 84.47%, also falling under the “Very Readable” category. The use of audiovisual media featuring animations based on the local culture of Pontianak is highly suitable for the learning process. This media has the potential to increa

title: PERAN GURU DALAM PEMBENTUKAN KARAKTER ISLAMI PESERTA DIDIK MADRASAH IBTIDAIYAH PADA ERA DIGITAL
abstract: This article presents a comprehensive literature review on the role of Madrasah Ibtidaiyah (MI) teachers in shaping students' Islamic character in the digital era. The purpose of this study is to synthesize various findings from leading literature to identify the multidimensional role of teachers, the innovative strategies implemented, and relevant challenges and solutions. This research uses a qualitative approach with a literature review method. The results of the study indicate that Islamic character education in Madrasah Ibtidaiyah is rooted in the values of the Qur'an and Hadith, which emphasize the formation of perfect human beings through the integration of moral, spiritual, and social values in the learning process. In addition, teachers play a multidimensional role as educators and digital role models who are able to instill Islamic ethics and balance religious values with the demands of the digital era.

title: PENERAPAN PROJECT BASED LEARNING BERBASIS ETNOSAINS MELALUI PROGRAM TABULAMPOT UNTUK MENINGKATKAN LITERASI SAINS DI SEKOLAH DASAR
abstract: Data from the 2022 PISA survey shows that Indonesian students' scientific literacy scores are low, ranking 69th out of 81 participating countries. The purpose of this study was to describe the application of project-based learning to improve scientific literacy integrated into Natural and Social Sciences subjects. This study used a quantitative method with a one-group pre-test and post-test design. The subjects were 28 sixth-grade students at Marsudirini Santa Theresia Elementary School. The results showed an increase in scientific literacy after the implementation of project-based learning. This result, based on the results of a hypothesis test using a paired sample t-test, showed a Sig. (2-tailed) of 0.000

title: ANAK, LAYAR, DAN PERKALIAN: MENCARI JALAN BERPIKIR KRITIS MELALUI FLIPPED CLASSROOM DI SEKOLAH DASAR
abstract: This research focuses on the impact of the flipped classroom model on second grade elementary school students' critical thinking skills in understanding multiplication. In the 21st century learning era, critical thinking is no longer just a plus; it is an essential ability that students must have in order to succeed and adapt amidst the flood of information. This study adopted a quantitative approach and used a quasi-experimental design. The research sample was selected using cluster random sampling technique, where class IIA served as the control class and class IIB as the experimental class. Data were collected through tests, observations, and documentation studies, then analyzed using descriptive and inferential statistics. The results showed that the flipped classroom model could be fully implemented up to 100%, starting from the preparation stage of the material at home to the active learning process in the classroom. The average pretest score for the control class was 43.15, while the experimental class had an average of 47.44. After the treatment, the average posttest score increased. title: MEMBANGUN GENERASI BERKARAKTER MELALUI IMPLEMENTASI PROFIL PELAJAR PANCASILA DALAM PEMBELAJARAN AKIDAH AKHLAK DI MADRASAH IBTIDAIYAH
abstract: This study aims to examine the implementation of the Pancasila Student Profile in Akidah Akhlak learning and analyze its influence on student character formation. The type of research used is qualitative with analysis stages including data reduction, data presentation, and conclusion drawing. Data were obtained through observations of Akidah Akhlak learning activities of grade V at MI NU Tarsyidut Thullab, interviews with subject teachers, and documentation during the learning process. The results of the study indicate that the implementation of the Pancasila Student Profile in Akidah Akhlak learning is carried out systematically through three main stages. In the planning stage, teachers prepare teaching modules tailored to student characteristics and the values of the Pancasila Student Profile. In the implementation stage, these values are integrated contextually in each learning material. In the evaluation stage, teachers assess students' cognitive, affective, and psychomotor aspects comprehensively. title: ANALISIS PROBLEMATIKA DAN ALTERNATIF STRATEGI PENGEMBANGAN BAHAN AJAR TEMATIK DI SEKOLAH DASAR
abstract: This study aims to identify problems and formulate alternative strategies for developing thematic teaching materials in elementary schools. The basis of this study is the limited development of thematic teaching materials in elementary schools and the lack of alternative development strategies by teachers. This study uses a qualitative approach with a literature review method. The data sources are articles in national journals over a period of 10 years (2014–2024). Based on the results obtained, it can be concluded that there are still several problems that must be addressed in the development of thematic teaching materials, including: teaching materials that are not in accordance with curriculum standards, teaching materials that are not integrated with local wisdom, and limited resources. Based on these problems, there are several alternative strategies for developing thematic teaching materials that can be implemented by teachers, including: multimedia integration, contextual relevance, and thematic-integrative learning models.

title: INOVASI MODEL PEMBELAJARAN INTERAKTIF DALAM MENGATASI KETERBATASAN BAHAN AJAR AQIDAH AKHLAK DI MADRASAH IBTIDAIYAH
abstract: Madrasah Ibtidaiyah, as an Islamic primary education institution, holds the responsibility of shaping a generation of Muslims with strong moral and spiritual integrity. One of the subjects that plays a crucial role in achieving this goal is Aqidah Akhlak (Islamic creed and ethics). However, the limited availability of contextual teaching materials that suit the characteristics of Madrasah Ibtidaiyah students poses a significant challenge in the learning process. This study aims to identify teachers’ strategies in overcoming the limitations of teaching materials and implementing interactive learning models in Aqidah Akhlak instruction. The research employed a qualitative descriptive method with data collected through observation, interviews, and documentation. The results show that teachers play an active role as developers of teaching materials and facilitators of learning through the use of Student Worksheets (LKS), storytelling, snowball throwing, group discussions, and simulations. The innovation in learning lies in the teachers’ efforts to combine these interactive models to overcome the limitation of conventional, text-based LKS materials. title: TRANSFORMASI PEMBELAJARAN: STRATEGI GURU KELAS DALAM MENINGKATKAN HASIL BELAJAR PESERTA DIDIK SLOW LEARNER DI SDI AL-CHUSNAINI
abstract: This research is motivated by the presence of slow learners in regular classes who experience difficulties in writing concentration and understanding teacher instructions. This is a challenging situation considering that not all students with special needs at SDI Al-Chusnaini have a shadow teacher (GPK). Thus, this research aims to describe teachers' strategies in improving the learning outcomes of slow learners at SDI Al-Chusnaini. The method used is a descriptive qualitative approach with interview and observation techniques. The research results indicate that teachers implement differentiated instruction by adjusting the difficulty level of the material and tasks, and using concrete and visual media. An emotional approach was also identified as an important factor in creating a positive learning environment. This finding indicates that adaptive, structured, and continuous learning strategies have a significant impact on the development of slow learners. This research is expected to provide recommendations for teachers in developing more effective learning strategies that are suitable for the needs of slow learners.

title: PENGEMBANGAN VIDEO ANIMASI KERAMA KEPEMIMPINAN RASULULLAH SAW DI MADINAH DALAM MEDIA EDUKASI POLITIK DI SEKOLAH DASAR
abstract: This study aims to develop a video animation–based learning medium called KERAMA (Leadership of the Prophet Muhammad SAW in Madinah) as an educational tool for teaching political education to sixth-grade elementary school students. The research employs the Design and Development (D&D) method using the ADDIE model, which consists of five stages: analysis, design, development, implementation, and evaluation. In the analysis stage, the researchers identified learning needs and selected material on the Prophet’s leadership in Madinah. During the design stage, storyboards, scripts, and visuals were created and tailored to the characteristics of elementary school students. In the development stage, the animation video was produced using Canva, Runway, and CapCut, resulting in an engaging and interactive presentation. The implementation stage involved testing the video in a sixth-grade classroom, engaging both teachers and students. Evaluation was conducted through expert validation and questionnaires to assess the feasibility and effectiveness of the video. title: HIZBUL WATHAN DAN DISIPLIN ANAK: LEBIH DARI SEKEDAR EKTRAKURIKULER
abstract: This research is motivated by the existence of extracurricular activities aimed at developing students' potential and skills outside the formal curriculum, thereby supporting the achievement of academic success and fostering positive character development among learners. This particular extracurricular activity is called Hizbul Wathan, which is specifically found in Muhammadiyah educational institutions. The Hizbul Wathan extracurricular activity. Therefore, this study seeks to describe how the Hizbul Wathan extracurricular activities at Muhammadiyah 1 Tenggarong Elementary School contribute to the development of students' positive character, particularly in terms of self-discipline. This research uses a descriptive qualitative approach, with data collection techniques that include observation, interviews, and documentation. title: THE INFLUENCE OF AUGMENTED REALITY MEDIA TO IMPROVE UNDERSTANDING CONCEPTS IN SOCIAL STUDIES LEARNING IN ELEMENTARY SCHOOLS
abstract: This research aims to determine the effect of using augmented reality media on increasing understanding of social studies learning concepts in elementary schools. This research is a quantitative research with a quasi-experimental design, namely a type of non equivalent control group design. The data collection techniques used are observation techniques, tests and questionnaires. Meanwhile, the sampling technique used saturated sampling with a sample size of 58 students. In addition, the data used in the research were analyzed using observation and questionnaire data analysis test, the N-Gain test, and the non-parametric hypothesis test, namely the Mann Whitney U test. The results of non-parametric hypothesis testing with the Mann Whitney U test, it shows that the significance value of 0.032 is smaller than 0.05, so Ha is rejected and H0 is accepted. This means that there is a significant influence between the use of augmented reality media on increasing understanding of social studies learning concepts in elementary schools.
